why_relevant: HR/people-focused trade site that carries bank senior-management change announcements alongside HR context (remit, reporting lines). Complements financial press by describing the organizational shape of the change.

Hungarian fintech trade news site covering payments/neobank players (Revolut, local fintechs) that mainstream bank desks under-cover; carried the Revolut Hungary leadership appointment and sector-restructuring pieces.

Marketing/media trade outlet that systematically republishes senior-appointment announcements, including bank CMO/communications and board-level changes. Adds coverage of marketing/CX leadership relevant to payments vendors.
Machine-readable index of Portfolio's per-section feeds (bank, gazdaság, üzlet, deviza, global). This is the operational entry point for automated low-latency A5 monitoring rather than HTML scraping.

Retail banking comparison portal with an editorial/news arm on Hungarian banks; named in the cell definition. Lower A5 yield (consumer-product focus) but occasionally covers bank strategy and branch-network/organizational change relevant to workstream A5.

The single richest English-language stream of Hungary-specific executive appointment items; carries bank and payments moves (MBH Bank deputy CEO, Citi Hungary CEO, ING Hungary HR head, Mastercard Hungary managers) in a dedicated, dated appointments feed.

source_name: Budapest Business Journal — 'Who's News' legacy archive
why_relevant: Older BBJ personnel-move items (K&H Bank names new CEO, Mastercard Hungary names new managers) live under a separate legacy path; needed for historical backfill of the appointment timeline.

CEE-specialist English wire covering Hungarian bank strategy, ownership and management reshuffles (OTP strategy, OTP Russia exposure, Banca Transilvania deal); personnel changes are usually framed inside strategy/regulatory stories rather than as standalone appointment notices.

source_name: Bloomberg — CEE / Hungary economy and banking desk
why_relevant: Breaks senior Hungarian financial-sector moves before local trade press, including cross-flows between banks and the state (e.g. the OTP head of research named chief of the Debt Management Agency, June 2026).

source_name: Reuters — Central Europe / Hungary finance coverage
why_relevant: Standard international wire of record for OTP/MNB-level statements on governance and CEO/chairman role separation; quotes from Sándor Csányi on splitting CEO and Chairman roles are an organisation-change signal.

source_name: MarketScreener — OTP Bank Nyrt. news feed (regulatory + wire syndication)
why_relevant: Aggregates OTP's English 'extraordinary announcements' (including the appointment of the General Deputy CEO) plus Reuters items — a practical workaround for paywalled wires and a machine-readable stream of statutory disclosure.

Primary English announcements of OTP management changes ('Stability and Renewal in the Management of OTP Bank') and the corporate-governance page listing current board/management — the authoritative baseline against which press reports are checked.

Scheme-level source for Hungary-relevant payments personnel: country managers for Hungary, Central Europe division presidents whose remit includes Hungary, and Hungarian nationals promoted to European/global roles.

source_name: Visa CEMEA / Europe newsroom press releases
why_relevant: Visa manages Hungary within CEMEA/Europe; regional president and country-lead appointments determine who owns the Hungarian market relationship. Announced in English only.
Foreign-owned bank publishing Hungary-specific appointments in English first (Hungary CEO, Hungary HR head); typical of the cross-border-group pattern this cell exists to capture.

source_name: Finextra — payments industry news and press-release channel
why_relevant: Global payments trade outlet that publishes vendor/PSP appointment press releases verbatim; Hungary-specific hits are sparse but it is the default channel if a Hungarian PSP or a vendor's CEE lead announces in English.

source_name: FinTech Futures — 'Job Cuts & New Hires' / movers-and-shakers section
why_relevant: A dedicated, deeply paginated personnel-moves vertical for fintech/payments globally, with monthly round-ups — the structurally best-shaped feed found for this topic, even though Hungarian entries are rare.

source_name: XpatLoop.com — Hungary English-language expat business news
why_relevant: Covers Hungarian bank leadership changes for an English-reading audience, including expat CEO arrivals (K&H Bank's incoming CEO from KBC Bulgaria) — useful for foreign-owned bank moves.

English-language aggregator of Hungarian press; carried the OTP CEO succession story and state financial-institution leadership shortlists. Fast but low-precision — good for lead generation, weak for verification.
English-language Hungarian news outlet covering state-linked financial institutions and government appointments touching banking; useful for the public/state-bank half of the personnel map.

source_name: Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) English press-release archive
why_relevant: The regulator publishes English releases on executive-director appointments at the MNB itself and on nominations to institutions it controls (e.g. the Budapest Stock Exchange CEO). Appointments of bank senior officers also require MNB approval, making its English pressroom an authoritative confirmation layer.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters — Hungary banking & finance coverage and comparative guides
why_relevant: English CEE professional-services outlet; tracks lateral moves of banking/finance practice heads and in-house counsel, which are early indicators of institutional reorganisations and deal-team build-ups in Hungarian banks.

source_name: Investing.com — Hungary financial-institution corporate news (wire syndication)
why_relevant: Carries English wire items on state financial institutions that trade press skips (e.g. Hungarian Export-Import Bank naming a new CEO and board members) — covers the policy-bank layer of the Hungarian sector.

source_name: Simply Wall St — OTP Bank leadership & management team page
why_relevant: Structured, dated roster of OTP board and senior management with tenure fields — a cheap machine-readable baseline for detecting when someone left or joined, to be confirmed against issuer disclosure.

source_name: ESMA / EU institutional CV and Board-of-Supervisors document archive (Hungarian members)
why_relevant: Publishes English CVs of Hungarian supervisory appointees (e.g. an MNB executive director's CV filed with the ESMA Board of Supervisors) — an authoritative, English, machine-readable biography source that reveals appointments indirectly.
Occasional English long-form profiles of Hungarian bankers; low volume but high signal for understanding the standing and trajectory of individual executives.

Largest Hungarian bank; company page carries employer-branding posts, new-hire welcomes, org/unit launches and the LinkedIn 'People' tab headcount-growth and function-mix curves, which are the densest quantitative proxy for hiring direction at OTP.

Post-merger entity (MKB + Takarékbank + Budapest Bank, 2023) still consolidating structure — the single richest Hungarian source of org-change and leadership-reshuffle signals, most announced first by individuals and the company page in Hungarian.
